+@nb.njit(fastmath=False)
+def qiu_support_norm_gradient(px, py, orientation_i, orientation_j, g_min,
+                              inclination_weight, support_power, angular_scale,
+                              energy_normalization):
+    delta = abs((orientation_i-orientation_j+np.pi/4)%(np.pi/2)-np.pi/4)
+    misorientation = g_min + (1-g_min)*np.sin(2*delta)**2
+    radius=np.sqrt(px*px+py*py)
+    radial_x=px/radius if radius>0 else 0.0
+    radial_y=py/radius if radius>0 else 0.0
+    c=np.cos(orientation_i);s=np.sin(orientation_i);a=c*px+s*py;b=-s*px+c*py
+    total=a**support_power+b**support_power
+    if total==0:
+        hi=hix=hiy=0.0
+    else:
+        scale=total**(1.0/support_power-1.0);da=scale*a**(support_power-1);db=scale*b**(support_power-1)
+        hi=total**(1.0/support_power);hix=c*da-s*db;hiy=s*da+c*db
+    c=np.cos(orientation_j);s=np.sin(orientation_j);a=c*px+s*py;b=-s*px+c*py
+    total=a**support_power+b**support_power
+    if total==0:
+        hj=hjx=hjy=0.0
+    else:
+        scale=total**(1.0/support_power-1.0);da=scale*a**(support_power-1);db=scale*b**(support_power-1)
+        hj=total**(1.0/support_power);hjx=c*da-s*db;hjy=s*da+c*db
+    prefactor=energy_normalization*misorientation*angular_scale
+    value=prefactor*((1-inclination_weight)*radius+0.5*inclination_weight*(hi+hj))
+    first_x=prefactor*((1-inclination_weight)*radial_x+0.5*inclination_weight*(hix+hjx))
+    first_y=prefactor*((1-inclination_weight)*radial_y+0.5*inclination_weight*(hiy+hjy))
+    return value,first_x,first_y
+

+@nb.njit(fastmath=False)
+def qiu_anisotropic_pair_drive_cell(phi,i,j,l,m,l_p,l_m,m_p,m_m,dx,orientation_i,
+                                     orientation_j,g_min,inclination_weight,support_power,
+                                     angular_scale,energy_normalization):
+    d=phi[i,l,m]-phi[j,l,m]
+    # Forward x/y bonds rooted at the current node.
+    px=(phi[i,l_p,m]-phi[j,l_p,m]-d)/dx
+    py=(phi[i,l,m_p]-phi[j,l,m_p]-d)/dx
+    norm,nxv,nyv=qiu_support_norm_gradient(px,py,orientation_i,orientation_j,g_min,inclination_weight,support_power,angular_scale,energy_normalization)
+    out_x=0.5*(norm*nxv-px)*dx;out_y=0.5*(norm*nyv-py)*dx
+    # Incoming x bond is rooted at (l-1,m), including that root's forward-y gradient.
+    d_left=phi[i,l_m,m]-phi[j,l_m,m]
+    px_left=(d-d_left)/dx
+    py_left=(phi[i,l_m,m_p]-phi[j,l_m,m_p]-d_left)/dx
+    norm,nxv,nyv=qiu_support_norm_gradient(px_left,py_left,orientation_i,orientation_j,g_min,inclination_weight,support_power,angular_scale,energy_normalization)
+    in_x=0.5*(norm*nxv-px_left)*dx
+    # Incoming y bond is rooted at (l,m-1), including that root's forward-x gradient.
+    d_down=phi[i,l,m_m]-phi[j,l,m_m]
+    px_down=(phi[i,l_p,m_m]-phi[j,l_p,m_m]-d_down)/dx
+    py_down=(d-d_down)/dx
+    norm,nxv,nyv=qiu_support_norm_gradient(px_down,py_down,orientation_i,orientation_j,g_min,inclination_weight,support_power,angular_scale,energy_normalization)
+    in_y=0.5*(norm*nyv-py_down)*dx
+    return (out_x+out_y-in_x-in_y)/(dx*dx)
+

+@nb.njit(fastmath=False)
+def qiu_anisotropic_mobility(phi,i,j,l,m,l_p,l_m,m_p,m_m,dx,orientation_i,
+                              orientation_j,pmobi,g_min,inclination_weight,support_power,
+                              mobility_exponent,angular_scale,energy_normalization,
+                              mobility_normalization):
+    gix=(phi[i,l_p,m]-phi[i,l_m,m])/(2*dx);giy=(phi[i,l,m_p]-phi[i,l,m_m])/(2*dx)
+    gjx=(phi[j,l_p,m]-phi[j,l_m,m])/(2*dx);gjy=(phi[j,l,m_p]-phi[j,l,m_m])/(2*dx)
+    normal_x=phi[i,l,m]*gjx-phi[j,l,m]*gix;normal_y=phi[i,l,m]*gjy-phi[j,l,m]*giy
+    theta=np.arctan2(normal_y,normal_x)
+    delta=abs((orientation_i-orientation_j+np.pi/4)%(np.pi/2)-np.pi/4)
+    misorientation=g_min+(1-g_min)*np.sin(2*delta)**2
+    c=np.cos(theta-orientation_i);s=np.sin(theta-orientation_i);hi=(c**support_power+s**support_power)**(1.0/support_power)
+    c=np.cos(theta-orientation_j);s=np.sin(theta-orientation_j);hj=(c**support_power+s**support_power)**(1.0/support_power)
+    gamma=energy_normalization*misorientation*angular_scale*((1-inclination_weight)+0.5*inclination_weight*(hi+hj))
+    return pmobi*mobility_normalization*gamma**(-mobility_exponent)
+
